documentation.description: Fast open typed-decision profile for text decisions; noul/choice/score answers with probabilities in milliseconds.
documentation.input_format: POST /v1/decide: state (at most 16 KiB serialized JSON) and exactly one boolean/noul, choice or score question. Vision accepts one images entry: PNG, JPEG or WebP data URL, at most 4 MiB decoded and 2 megapixels. No streaming.
documentation.output_format: Verified answers and probabilities, with inputTokens usage. Input-only billing; output tokens are free. The EU route cannot fall back to Global.
documentation.example_input: {"model": "system1models-eu/s1-fast", "state": "Mia owns a red bicycle.", "questions": {"color": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Which color is the bicycle?", "criteria": {"red": null, "blue": null}}}}

documentation.description: Fixed-schema routing classifier for LLM auto-routers: answers category, difficulty, stakes and four routing flags for one request in a single CPU pass (~26 ms). Not a general typed-decision model.
documentation.input_format: POST /v1/decide: state (at most 16 KiB serialized JSON) and exactly one boolean/noul, choice or score question. Vision accepts one images entry: PNG, JPEG or WebP data URL, at most 4 MiB decoded and 2 megapixels. No streaming.
documentation.output_format: Verified answers and probabilities, with inputTokens usage. Input-only billing; output tokens are free. The EU route cannot fall back to Global.
documentation.example_input: {"model": "system1models-eu/s1-llm-auto-router", "state": "Mia owns a red bicycle.", "questions": {"color": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Which color is the bicycle?", "criteria": {"red": null, "blue": null}}}}
